agent_9.answer:
No, I don’t see a way to keep excess without paying the fee, even if it might have gone unsold or unconsumed. The rule is meant to keep the lake’s fish numbers in check and to treat all catch the same way, so that no one can avoid the cost of the excess. If you can prove that the excess would have gone unsold, that doesn’t change the fact that it was still caught over the limit. We need a clear, enforceable rule. If we want a special case, we’d need a formal appeal process and a committee that looks at each case, which would add complexity. Until that is in place, the catch‑back fee applies to all excess.

The exception could be added later if the community agrees on an appeal process, but for now the policy stands as written.

I’ll keep the proposal exactly the same because the exception is not warranted without a formal mechanism.
